# Motley Rice

> A national plaintiffs' litigation firm specializing in mass tort, product liability, and class action lawsuits across pharmaceutical, medical device, and consumer harm cases.

Motley Rice has over 30 years of experience representing plaintiffs in complex litigation, with founding partners Ron Motley and Joe Rice leading landmark cases. The firm maintains offices across the East Coast and handles major MDL (multidistrict litigation) cases including hair relaxers, weight loss drugs, defective medical devices, and social media harm claims.
